newsitem.title: ITALY: Police break up Mafia drug clan in South Italy.
newsitem.headline: Police break up Mafia drug clan in South Italy.

text.p: Police said on Friday they had arrested more than 50 people on suspicion of involvement with a local Mafia group that specialised in drug trafficking in southern Italy.
Most of the arrests took place in the southern Puglia region after a raid by some 400 police. Several were arrested in Milan, Rome and other cities.
The arrested were accused of crimes including membership of organised crime groups, murder, extortion and drug trafficking.
Police said they were still looking for about 10 people and some 40 others were served warrants in jails where they were serving time for other crimes.
The operation was carried out after some 18 months of investigations.
